sonicScene.thesis: A black hole is eating a star: the star is stretched into a stream of plasma that pours into a Doppler-bright disk, every note tears another fragment off it, and the bass is the hole's own mass bending the sky.

composition.background: the galaxy's band of stars over a deep indigo-to-teal sky, lensed into arcs round the shadow
composition.midground: the accretion disk on a shallow diagonal, its approaching (left) side blazing blue-white and its receding (right) side deep red; its far side lensed up over the shadow and under it
composition.foreground: tumbling wreckage of shattered planets, scanned rock rimmed by the disk
composition.focal: the shadow and its razor photon ring, on the right third
secondary: the victim star, stretched along its orbit, and the plasma stream it bleeds into the disk
composition.atmosphere: none (vacuum): glowing gas and dust only
composition.post: bloom and warm halation on the inner disk, a whisper of anamorphic streak, edge chromatic aberration, grain, a heavy vignette
composition.camera: a 32-degree arc swept there and back over 160 s, a few degrees above the disk plane

palette.saturation: highest in the disk; the star and the jets the cold counterweight

medium: the star's orbit (40 s), passing behind the hole once a lap
fast: note fragments torn off the star, falling in over 3-4 s
extremely_fast: the photon ring flash and shock (kick)

vocabulary: the disk heats: every band brighter, the gas denser and whiter
each note tears a clump of fragments off the star (it flares); the pitch sets how it falls: a low note swings wide, a high note plunges steeply, trailing light
how many fragments and how bright
a chord tears off a cluster: the birthplace spreads
the hole's mass: the lens and the shadow swell, the sky bends more, and the star flares and bleeds faster into its stream
the photon ring flashes, the jets fire and a shock ripple races out from the hole
a flare erupts from the hot spot on the approaching side, and the star sheds a burst of plasma
busy playing churns the gas (turbulence, finer streaks)
a bright timbre turns the inner edge from gold to blue-white
the hole keeps eating: the star circles and bleeds, the disk turns, the jets whisper
sonicScene.tier: live: no fog march; one DF lens, two lights, scanned debris, ten particle systems
sonicScene.title: Event Horizon
